meta.name: The Bold Caballero
meta.description:
This is the Magnacolor print

Zorro (Robert Livingston) has been captured and set for execution, charged with the murder of the new Governor (Robert Warwick) in Spanish California, as the Governor was marked with a "Z". 
Zorro escapes, and reveals his identity to the Governor's daughter, Isabella (Heather Angel). However, Isabella then has Don Diego arrested. 
He convinces Isabella that the Commandante (Sig Ruman) was the real killer, as the "Z" on the Governor was backwards.
